title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten no-admission, under-21-safe ways to spend time on campus and in Iowa City.

cards.title: Walk the Stanley galleries
cards.subtitle: 160 W. Burlington St. · Iowa City
cards.notes: Meet in the lobby, choose a floor, and take a self-paced lap through the galleries. Check the museum’s visit page for current opening days.
cards.short_summary: A free museum stop with changing exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to the Stanley Museum of Art is always free.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Stanley Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Open hours and scheduled closures are listed on the museum visit page; admission ends five minutes before gallery closing.

cards.entity_name: Stanley Museum of Art Touch Tour
cards.title: Book a Stanley touch tour
cards.subtitle: Stanley Museum of Art · Iowa City
cards.notes: For visitors who are blind or partially sighted and companions, arrange an educator-led tactile gallery visit in advance for a focused group outing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Stanley offers free touch tours by appointment for visitors who are blind or partially sighted and their companions.
cards.access_notes: Available by appointment in groups of three plus companions; the museum requests four weeks’ advance notice.

cards.title: Explore Old Capitol Museum
cards.subtitle: 21 N. Clinton St. · Iowa City
cards.notes: Use a self-guided visit to move through the historic building and exhibits together. Groups of more than 10 are asked to schedule ahead.
cards.short_summary: A free self-guided museum visit on the Pentacrest.
cards.evidence_claim: Old Capitol Museum self-guided visits have no charge and museum admission is always free.
cards.source_title: Group Visits & Tours | Old Capitol Museum
cards.access_notes: Self-guided visits are self-paced; the museum asks groups larger than 10 to schedule in advance.

cards.title: Browse Iowa Hall
cards.subtitle: Museum of Natural History · Macbride Hall
cards.notes: Set a meet-up point at Macbride Hall, then explore Iowa Hall at your own pace. Larger self-guided groups should reserve ahead.
cards.short_summary: A named gallery within the free Museum of Natural History.
cards.evidence_claim: Iowa Hall is available for no-charge self-guided visits, and Museum of Natural History admission is always free.
cards.source_title: Group Visits & Tours | University of Iowa Museum of Natural History
cards.access_notes: The museum lists Iowa Hall for self-guided visits and asks groups of more than 10 to schedule in advance.

cards.title: Look through Bird Hall
cards.subtitle: Museum of Natural History · Macbride Hall
cards.notes: Plan a slow loop through Bird Hall and compare what each person notices. Keep the visit self-guided to retain the no-charge access.
cards.short_summary: A named natural-history gallery for a self-paced visit.
cards.evidence_claim: Bird Hall is available for no-charge self-guided visits, and Museum of Natural History admission is always free.
cards.source_title: Group Visits & Tours | University of Iowa Museum of Natural History
cards.access_notes: The museum lists Bird Hall for self-guided visits and asks groups of more than 10 to schedule in advance.

cards.title: Tour Mammal Hall at your pace
cards.subtitle: Museum of Natural History · Macbride Hall
cards.notes: Make Mammal Hall the destination for a short between-classes stop or a longer museum wander. No ticket purchase is needed for self-guided entry.
cards.short_summary: A free named gallery in Macbride Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Mammal Hall is available for no-charge self-guided visits, and Museum of Natural History admission is always free.
cards.source_title: Group Visits & Tours | University of Iowa Museum of Natural History
cards.access_notes: The museum lists Mammal Hall for self-guided visits and asks groups of more than 10 to schedule in advance.

cards.title: Check out a TREKsack
cards.subtitle: Iowa Hall front desk · Macbride Hall
cards.notes: Ask at the Iowa Hall front desk for a free TREKsack, then use its books and sensory tools while exploring the Museum of Natural History.
cards.evidence_claim: TREKsacks are free to check out at the Iowa Hall front desk.
cards.source_title: TREKsacks | University of Iowa Museum of Natural History
cards.access_notes: Ask the Iowa Hall front desk about availability; the program includes sensory-support items and books.

cards.title: See the Main Library Gallery
cards.subtitle: Main Library north entrance · Iowa City
cards.notes: Enter through the Main Library’s north entrance and take in the current exhibition together. Pair it with a free gallery talk when one is scheduled.
cards.short_summary: A public exhibition space for rare objects and archives.
cards.evidence_claim: All Main Library Gallery exhibits and associated programming are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Plan your visit to the Main Library Gallery
cards.access_notes: General-public visitors may stop by during open hours; access is via the Main Library’s north entrance.

cards.title: Take a greenhouse reset
cards.subtitle: Biology Building East, fourth floor
cards.notes: Visit the fourth-floor greenhouse with a friend for a quiet plant-filled break. Call ahead if you want to arrange a group tour.
cards.short_summary: A public indoor plant collection above downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: The Biology Greenhouse is open to the general public on weekdays, and the university identifies it among campus experiences with free admission.
cards.source_title: Three Things You Need to Experience on the University of Iowa Campus
cards.access_notes: Open to the general public weekdays from 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m; closed on university holidays. Call ahead for group tours.

cards.title: Ride an Iowa City Transit route
cards.subtitle: Iowa City Transit · Iowa City
cards.notes: Choose a route, ride to a nearby stop, and make the trip itself the hang. Confirm route-specific service times before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A fare-free way to move around Iowa City.
cards.evidence_claim: Bus fares are free in Iowa City through the Fare Free Iowa City pilot.
cards.access_notes: Iowa City Transit operates 13 fixed routes Monday through Saturday; service hours vary by route.

warnings: Museum and transit schedules can change; check the linked official pages before heading out.
